data.name: Aqmar
data.gender_notes: Aqmar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'aqama' meaning 'to be bright, clear, or distinct'. In Islamic tradition, Aqmar is a name given to a child born under the star of the same name, believed to bring wisdom and enlightenment. The name Aqmar carries the meaning “The Bright One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aqmar usually hope their child will grow to embody the bright one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's guidance and protection
data.etymology: Aqmar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Bright One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aqmar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: أقمر
in_arabic.meaning: القمر المنير أو الشخص الذي يشبه القمر في جماله
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أقمر مشتق من الجذر اللغوي قمر والذي يعني القمر، ويطلق على الشخص الذي يشبه القمر في جماله أو نوره، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية أن القمر هو آيات الله في السماء الدنيا، فمن أسماء الله الحسنى القمر الذي يمثل نوره الإلهي في الكون، ويحمل الاسم دلالات روحية تتعلق بالضوء والإيمان.

in_urdu.name: اقمر
in_urdu.meaning: چاند جیسا خوبصورت یا روشن چہرہ والا شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم اقمر کا مطلب ہے چاند کی طرح روشن یا خوبصورت چہرے والا، یہ نام عربی جڑ قمر سے ماخوذ ہے جو چاند کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اسلامی تقویم میں چاند کی اہمیت کو دیکھتے ہوئے، یہ نام روحانی اور دینی سیاق و سباق میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں یہ نام خوبصورت اور اچھے معنی کا حامل ہے.

in_hindi.name: अक्मर
in_hindi.meaning: चाँद जैसा सुंदर या उज्ज्वल चेहरा वाला व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: अक्मर नाम का अर्थ है चाँद की तरह सुंदर या उज्ज्वल चेहरा वाला, यह नाम अरबी मूल के शब्द चमर से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ चाँद होता है, इस्लामी परंपरा में चाँद की महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका को देखते हुए, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में सुंदरता और प्रकाश के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है.

in_pashto.name: اقمر
in_pashto.meaning: د چمکړي سپوږمۍ په څير ښکلی مخ درلودونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د اقمر نوم مطلب دے د چمکړي سپوږمۍ په څير ښکلی مخ درلودونکی، دا نوم د عربي کلمې قمر څخه اخیستل شوی دے، چي د سپوږمۍ معنی ورکوي، په پښتني کلتور کې دا نوم د ښکلا او نور په معنا کارول کېږي، او د افغاني او پښتني مسلمانو لپاره دا نوم ډیر تقدس لري.

in_english.name: Aqmar
in_english.meaning: Person with a face as beautiful as the moon
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aqmar originates from the Arabic root 'qamar,' meaning moon, signifying someone whose face shines like the moon, in Islamic tradition, the moon holds significant spiritual and cosmological importance, symbolizing divine light, guidance, and beauty, hence, Aqmar embodies these qualities, implying a person of great beauty, spirituality, and inner light.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aqmar holds significant cultural weight in certain Middle Eastern and Muslim communities. It refers to a star in the Big Dipper constellation, and is believed to bring good fortune and protect against evil. Naming a child Aqmar is a way to bestow these blessings upon them.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aqmar is believed to hold deep symbolism in Islamic tradition. It is said that a child born under this star will be blessed with wisdom, knowledge, and enlightenment. The name is also believed to represent clarity and distinction in one's spiritual journey, serving as a reminder to stay focused on the path towards God. Additionally, some believe that the name holds protective qualities, shielding the bearer from harm and darkness. Ultimately, the name Aqmar is seen as a source of spiritual strength and guidance.
